verdict.rationale: Docs confirm external sharing exists and can be configured/managed (onedrive-docs-9) and that sharing links can be created programmatically (onedrive-docs-13/19), implying admin-level control surfaces, but the evidence pack lacks specifics on domain allowlists, org-wide external sharing toggles, or link-type restrictions actually documented in depth. missing for 10: detailed docs on domain allowlist configuration, tenant-level external sharing policy settings, link expiration/restriction controls, and independent/hands-on confirmation these admin controls work as described.
